podcast.body: This song was a surprise hit for Dr. Hook & The Medicine Show in 1970, helping establish the band's early career. "They also kind of had a surprise hit to their name called Sylvia's mother that was a hit in 1970."

podcast.body: This "ultra depressing hit" was performed on Top of the Pops prior to David Bowie and The Spiders from Mars' iconic July 6, 1972, performance. "After Dr. Hook and the medicine show played their ultra depressing hit Sylvia's mother."
